text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit southbound left-turn movements at all times on Martin Grove Road at the driveway access to 1345 Martin Grove Road, located approximately 55 metres south of Racine Road. The proposed turn prohibition, a requirement of site plan approval for the redevelopment of the property at the southeast corner of the intersection of Martin Grove Road and Racine Road, will help mitigate any interference with southbound traffic within the functional area of the northbound approach of the intersection of Martin Grove Road and Racine Road. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) provides service on Martin Grove Road, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit southbound left-turn movements at all times on Martin Grove Road at the driveway access to 1345 Martin Grove Road, located approximately 55 metres south of Racine Road.
